Best Banh Xeo in Nha Trang
Oct 2026 • Solo
I think I visited three or four times while staying in Nha Trang. I think this place is the best for Banh Xeo. Compared to other restaurants, the variety of vegetables served is the most diverse, and the quality of the Banh Xeo itself is excellent. All the staff are so friendly, and they always greet you with a smile, which makes me feel good every time I come. If I visit Nha Trang again, I will come back. I ate well and enjoyed it. Thank you.
